references.text: The preceding text in the same chapter establishes the valuation system for adult persons (ages 20–60) who are dedicated to the Lord, and provides context for the child assessment in verse 6.
The following verse continues the valuation system for persons over age 60, showing the complete age-based assessment structure for those dedicated to the Lord.
Here the Levites are counted from one month of age and upward, the same minimum age mentioned in Leviticus 27:6 for value assessment.
God commands Moses to count all firstborn Israelite male children from one month of age and upward, parallel to the minimum age in Leviticus 27:6.
The redemption price of five shekels of silver for firstborn boys from one month of age and upward corresponds exactly to the amount for male children in Leviticus 27:6.
Describes the sanctuary shekel as the standard monetary value, the same unit of measure used for the valuation in Leviticus 27:6.
